Name: Item Ball Dig Spot
Author: DZK312
Description:
Replaces the artifact worm dig spot sprite and animation with that of an item ball from Pokemon.
Using the config.json you can choose between an item ball sprite from generations 1-5.
The generation 1 and 2 sprites bob/bounce while the generation 3, 4, and 5 sprites jiggle/roll back and forth.

Requires Content Patcher to use, just download this and drop it in your folder with your other CP mods.



I hope you enjoy my second ever posted mod :)

If you like this mod, check out my Faciful Resources mod :D
